equipment_type: Energy recovery make-up air unit controller
applies_to: AbsolutAire heating and ventilating units with plate or heat-pipe heat recovery, supply and exhaust fans, controlled by the ER-3 control system.
summary: The ER-3 controls AbsolutAire make-up air units with heat recovery, supply and exhaust fans, burner and optional cooling. It joins a BACnet MS/TP network with a device instance built from its DIP-switch MAC address. The BMS writes the fan command, HVAC mode, occupancy, setpoints and fan speed or space temperature overrides, and reads temperatures, humidity, heat recovery effectiveness and energy, fan and heat status and many alarm objects.
default_device_instance: 3640 followed by the MAC address (e.g. MAC 25 = 364025)
notes: Taken from the Network Points List (pp16-17) of the ER-3 user guide, which is printed as an image; the values were read by OCR and checked row by row against the page.

AbsolutAire's table also lists the controller's physical I/O as 'Hardware Input n' / 'Hardware Output n' (28 rows) without a BACnet object type, so they are left out. The guide marks them do-not-write; use the network_ values and status objects instead.
Object names are kept as printed, including typos such as "Burner Not Responding Allram".
Multistate state texts are given in the guide only as enumeration names (Fan Command, HVAC Mode, Occupancy, Reliability); read State_Text on the device for the numbering.
AV 1-6, BV 1-8 and MV 1-3 are unit configuration variables; the guide says not to write them.

integration.summary: Write network Fan Command (MV 21) to enable/disable the unit, network Occupancy Command (MV 23) and network HVAC Mode (MV 22), plus the heat/cool setpoints (AV 36-39). Writing 255 to the fan speed or space temperature overrides (AV 47-49) returns them to automatic control. Read discharge temperature, fan and heat status and the alarm multistates.

minimum_points.name: network Fan Command
minimum_points.why: Fan command; enables or disables the unit

minimum_points.name: network HVAC Mode
minimum_points.why: HVAC mode: Vent, Heat or Cool

integration.enable: MV 21 network Fan Command is the point the guide says to use to enable or disable the unit.
integration.remote_sensors: AV 49 network Space Temperature overrides the local space temperature (255 = local). AV 57 shows the local value and AV 66 the value used for control. AV 47/48 override supply and exhaust fan speed (255 = automatic).
setup: BACnet MS/TP only. The controller detects the network baud rate after a power cycle.
MAC address is set on the 8 DIP switches on the controller (switch 1 = LSB, binary). Units ship with a factory MAC, incremented per unit on a project.
Device instance is fixed at 3640 followed by the MAC address (MAC 25 = 364025); change the MAC to fix a duplicate instance.
gotchas: Do not override the hardware outputs from the BMS: each override raises a Hardware Output n Override alarm (MV 42-53).
MV 33 Low Temperature Alarm is reset by commanding the unit off then on.
BV 24 Burner Reset must be pulsed to Reset for about 3 seconds, then returned to Normal.
